title: Set up Community
subtitle: This page is only available until the first install finishes.

language.title: Choose a language
language.hint: Used for this wizard, as the server’s default language and for the administrator account.
language.label: Language

token.title: Enter the setup token
token.hint: The one-time token is printed in the server log at startup (look for “setup token”).
token.label: Setup token

mode.title: What do you want to do?
mode.misskeyHint: Move an existing Misskey server here, keeping its domain, accounts, posts, keys and remote followers.
mode.mastodonHint: Move an existing Mastodon server here, keeping its domain, accounts, posts, keys and remote followers.

domain.title: Public address
domain.hint: The address people use to reach this server, e.g. https://social.example.com.
domain.label: Public URL
domain.permanent: The domain can’t be changed after install: it becomes part of every account and post address on the fediverse.
domain.detectedHint: A migration keeps the original domain so remote servers keep recognising your accounts. Point this domain at the new server before going live.
domain.notDetected: The domain could not be detected from the source. Enter the Misskey server’s exact public URL.
domain.chooseDetected: Multiple domains were detected. Select the original site’s public address.

db.title: Database
db.name: Database name
db.sqliteHint: SQLite suits small or test instances.
db.emptyHint: The target database must be empty.
db.builtinHint: Uses the database connection configured by Docker Compose.

source.title: Misskey database
source.hint: Connect to the Misskey PostgreSQL database. It is only read, never changed. Stop Misskey (or use a copy) so nothing changes during the migration.
source.name: Database name
source.found: Found {users} local accounts, {remote} remote accounts, {notes} posts and {files} media files.
source.filesHint: The directory mounted into this container that holds Misskey’s files (usually …/misskey/files).
source.modeReferenceHint: Keep the original media URLs. Nothing is copied; the bucket must stay online.
source.modeCopyHint: Copy the source site’s media files. Interrupted copies can resume.
source.secretKept: Leave empty to use the key saved in Misskey.
source.idMethodHint: Not detected automatically. Use the id value from the original Misskey default.yml configuration.

admin.title: Administrator
admin.hintMisskey: Enter an existing Misskey user to make them owner, or a new name to create a separate administrator.
admin.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. For an existing Misskey user the original password keeps working; this one is only used for a new account.
admin.passwordHintMigration: At least 8 characters. Migrated accounts keep their passwords; this is used only for a new administrator.

review.title: Ready to install
review.hint: Settings will be saved to {path}. You will be taken to the login page when installation is complete.

progress.title: Installing
progress.running: Working… you can leave this page open; progress is saved.
progress.redirecting: Server is back. Taking you to sign in…
progress.failed: A step failed. Fix the cause and retry; finished steps are not repeated.

errors.network: Can’t reach the server. Check that it is still running.
errors.rate_limited: Too many wrong attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.invalid_domain: Enter a valid https:// URL (http:// only for localhost).
errors.domain_mismatch: The domain must match the source server’s domain.
errors.invalid_database_host: The database host is not valid.
errors.invalid_database_port: The database port is not valid.
errors.invalid_database_sslmode: The SSL mode is not valid.
errors.database_connect_failed: Could not connect to the database.
errors.database_not_empty: This database already contains Community data. Use an empty database.
errors.invalid_redis_address: The Redis address must look like host:port.
errors.invalid_username: Usernames may use letters, numbers and underscores (1–30).
errors.weak_password: The password must have at least 8 characters.
errors.admin_email_taken: That email belongs to another account.
errors.misskey_fields_required: Fill in the Misskey database fields.
errors.misskey_connect_failed: Could not connect to the Misskey database.
errors.misskey_not_misskey: That database doesn’t look like a Misskey database.
errors.misskey_files_missing: The files directory doesn’t exist inside the container.
errors.object_storage_fields_required: Fill in endpoint, bucket, access key and secret key.
errors.object_storage_failed: Could not read from the object storage.
errors.no_job: There is no installation to retry.
errors.secrets_missing: Saved credentials are missing; restart the wizard.
errors.config_write_failed: Could not write the configuration file.
errors.schema_failed: Could not create the database schema.
errors.meta_import_failed: Could not import the instance settings.
errors.export_tool_missing: The export tool (python3/psql) is missing from this image.
errors.preflight_blocked: The export has problems that block the import. See the log.
errors.interrupted: The server stopped during this step.
errors.setup_mode: The server is in setup mode.
errors.mastodon_fields_required: Fill in the Mastodon database fields.
errors.mastodon_connect_failed: Could not connect to the Mastodon database.
errors.mastodon_not_mastodon: That database doesn’t look like a Mastodon database.
errors.mastodon_files_missing: The public/system directory doesn’t exist inside the container.
errors.builtin_database_unavailable: No built-in database is available in this deployment. Choose another database type.

mastodon.title: Mastodon database
mastodon.hint: Connect to the Mastodon PostgreSQL database. It is only read, never changed. Stop Mastodon (or use a copy) so nothing changes during the migration.
mastodon.found: Found {users} local accounts, {remote} remote accounts, {notes} posts and {files} media files.
mastodon.filesHint: The directory mounted into this container that holds Mastodon’s uploads (usually …/mastodon/public/system).
mastodon.storageHint: Use the values from Mastodon’s .env.production (S3_ENDPOINT, S3_BUCKET, AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID…). The secret key is never read from the database.
mastodon.notDetected: The domain could not be detected from the source. Enter the Mastodon server’s exact public URL (LOCAL_DOMAIN).
mastodon.adminHint: Enter an existing Mastodon user to make them owner (their password keeps working), or a new name to create a separate administrator.
